summary: Small dead-end lot between shops, off a larger car park; homes over 30 m away.

Nearest dwellings 33 m or more from best section
Room for a van beside the few parked cars

drivers.traffic: Back lot, tucked away from the street; only car park movements.
drivers.convention: Part of a commercial car park area; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Mapped as private parking, access may be restricted
House 16 m from the south end of the outline
sun_shade: Open to sky; buildings to the east and west shade the morning and afternoon edges, trees on the east side.
